profile.summary: Western Governors University (WGU) is a nonprofit, online university founded in 1997. It offers bachelor's and master's degrees, certificates and teacher licensure programs in business, education, technology, and health and nursing. Its programs are competency-based, meaning students advance by showing what they have learned.
